missions.title: Shakedown
missions.briefing: Lindqvist, courier desk. Before I trust you with real cargo, show me what the Armstrong can do: out to {far}, the farthest body from the sun, and back here to {start}. Each leg against the clock.

objectives.hint: Set a course for {far} ({far.distance} s). Out of time and the run starts again from where you are.
Set a course back to {start} ({start.distance} s).

missions.debrief: Not bad at all. You'll do. I have a real job for you.

missions.title: Medicine Run
missions.briefing: A fever is spreading through the survey crew at {clinic}. The vaccine is at {depot}. Pick up the crates and get them there before the timer runs out.

objectives.text: Pick up the vaccine at {depot} and deliver it to {clinic}
objectives.hint: Orbit {depot} to load the crates, then set a course for {clinic}. Out of time and a new run is set up.

missions.debrief: Crates delivered and the crew are on the mend. That's what this ship is for.

missions.title: Tow Line
missions.briefing: Lindqvist. Not cargo this time: the freighter {hauler} lost her engines, and her reactor is going. Her crew got off, her cargo didn't. Get a line on her and drag her to {port} before the reactor fails: the yard there can shut it down.

objectives.hint: Set course for the freighter, then SCAN her from within range.
COME ALONGSIDE: her reactor's clock starts once you are.
TAKE IN TOW (the tractor must work). Flights are slower with her on the line.

objectives.text: Tow her into orbit of {port} before her reactor fails
objectives.hint: Set course for {port} with her in tow. The card counts her reactor down.

missions.debrief: The yard crews cold-started her reactor with a minute to spare. Her owners want to know which courier tows ships for fun.

missions.title: Mail Circuit
missions.briefing: Three parcels aboard for three bodies: {mail_a}, {mail_b} and {mail_c}. Any order you like, one timer for the lot.

objectives.hint: Each parcel is delivered when you enter orbit of its body. Plan the shortest round.

missions.debrief: Every parcel signed for. Half the system has letters from home tonight.

missions.title: Twelve Lifepods
missions.briefing: Lindqvist, and this isn't a delivery. The liner {liner} broke up: twelve lifepods, each on its own air. The Armstrong's hold takes a few people at a time, so it will be runs to {station} and back. Go.

objectives.hint: Set course for the pods and SCAN them.
PICK UP PODS (least air first). When the hold is full, fly to {station} and set the survivors down (ship status hold: DROP), then come back.
At {station}: ship status, hold, DROP the survivors.

missions.debrief: Every pod we reached is in, and the people in them are warm, fed and asking for us by name. Lindqvist says that's the run she'll remember.

missions.title: Diplomatic Pouch
missions.briefing: A sealed diplomatic pouch, for hand delivery only, to the station at {moon}, the outermost moon. Get there and hold orbit while they come up to collect it.

objectives.hint: Stay in orbit while the courier comes up for the pouch.

missions.debrief: Pouch received, seal unbroken. Somebody important is very pleased with us.

missions.title: Against the Clock
missions.briefing: Two jobs back to back and no slack in either. Reactor parts from {parts_from} to {parts_to}, and from there a medical team on to wherever they are needed. Go.

objectives.hint: Load at {parts_from}, deliver at {parts_to}. Out of time and both jobs start again.
They are aboard: set a course for {team_to} ({team_to.distance} s).

missions.debrief: Both on time. Lindqvist signing off with a rare compliment: best courier I have had on this run. That's the chapter, Armstrong.
